training.router_aggregation: valid-token-weighted mean of microbatch auxiliary losses

training.padding: single-document rows, trim right padding to common multiple of 64, maximum context 4096

scope: Controlled from-scratch architecture study; common protocol. Not a reproduction of published 100B-token scores.

comparison: same width/depth/experts/tokenizer/seed/token order; parameter differences reported, not equal-FLOP by assertion

Shared reduced head dimensions across controls; not original head counts or state dimensions

131072 nominal token slots per update (32 document rows); valid target tokens vary with document lengths, rather than the published 0.5M-token batch
network: mandatory OS denial; no online mode
